title: Coverage by a joined field
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be a type and let $fs$ be a nonempty finite list of finite lists of elements of $\Gamma$. For every integer $p$ with $-1\le p\le$ the length of the list formed by joining the fields with single blank separators, there is an index $j<|fs|$ such that $p$ measured relative to the starting offset of field $j$ lies between $-1$ and the length of that field, inclusive.
hypotheses_covered: Integer $p$ is at most the length of the joined fields
There exists a valid field index with relative offset in the stated inclusive bounds
